suite: Android app code (Flutter web preview, ORDER_MODE=api) on the real local backend orders, DEVELOPMENT payment provider
note: The same Dart code as the APK, run in the browser preview. Razorpay's Android screen cannot run in a browser and no Razorpay credentials exist on this machine: the provider's own screen is NOT exercised here. The real device is verified by the owner (USER DEVICE VERIFICATION = PENDING).

results.name: A0 the app signs in against the local backend (same Dart code as the APK, ORDER_MODE=api)

B1 THE PROVIDER'S SUCCESS IS REPORTED, THE BACKEND VERIFIES — AND THE APP WAITS FOR THE SERVER'S ORDER: the screen moved to /order-confirmation/FOTG-… on its own (the number the payment answer named); the phone posted nothing but the report
B2 DATABASE: exactly one order for the checkout — WAITING_FOR_RESTAURANT, PAID, refund NONE, the checkout's total, version 1 — and the payment's fulfilment is ORDER_CREATED

B3 THE CONFIRMATION SCREEN renders THE REAL ORDER read from GET /customer/orders/{number}: "Order confirmed" on screen; the answer the app rendered carries the number, WAITING_FOR_RESTAURANT, PAID, the total and the pickup code the server issued (screenshot m31-01-order-confirmation.png shows them; no "development order" notice)

results.name: B4 THE PHONE KEEPS NO ORDER OF ITS OWN: the order, its number and its pickup code are not in the app's storage — only the session; nothing of the payment's proof either

C1 APP KILLED AND STARTED AGAIN ON THE CONFIRMATION: the app reads the order from the backend again (GET /customer/orders/{number}) — the same number and the same pickup code come back, still ONE order, nothing posted

C2 OPENING THE PAYMENT SCREEN AGAIN after the order exists: the app has nothing left to pay for (the hand-off dropped the paid checkout) or goes to the order — it starts nothing, posts nothing, and there is still one order and one payment
